newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Staples 1997 EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Staples 1997 EPS cut.

text.p: -- Furman Selz analyst Kimberly Walin cut her 1997 profit estimates for Staples Inc by a nickel on Tuesday after the U.S. Federal Trade Commission rejected its proposed merger with Office Depot Inc, according to a research report.
-- She cut earnings per share estimate to $0.85 from $0.90 a share "to be conservative," the report said, to exclude any accretion from a merger in the 1997 estimate.

-- "On a stand-alone basis, Staples operating trends remain very impressive, by far the best of the sector ... Staples is now trading at 27 times our fiscal 1997 estimate. Our stand-alone growth rate for Stapels remains at 30 percent," the report said.
-- Staples shares closed at 23-1/4 on Monday.
